children: AI cloud stocks were higher in early trading even after Big Short investor Steve Eisman said on CNBC that the so-called neoclouds would be the biggest losers from the turmoil at Nvidia Corp.
shares were up 3.44% and CoreWeave Inc.

Eisman described Nvidia as a virtual vertical holding company and it's unwinding, and said the neoclouds, which borrowed heavily to build data centers, are part of that structure and at risk of being cut loose. Both CoreWeave and Nebius have fallen more than 50% over the past three months. Investors are concerned that, as scrutiny of its China revenue grows, Nvidia may pull back on the financing that has supported much of the AI industry. The Commerce Department has also moved to close a loophole on China's remote use of data centers.

Nvidia reports quarterly results after the close today, its first since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO last week. Eisman said his bigger concern is how far state and local governments will slow data center construction. He said a slowdown of 10% to 30% would favor the hyperscalers, whose cash flow would turn positive again.

title: Steve Eisman Says AI Neoclouds Face 'Big Trouble' After Nvidia Fallout
